Wiper system: - Windscreen wipers have several operating modes: slow, fast, intermittent, and automatic with rain sensor.
- Rain sensor adjusts wipe frequency based on rain intensity.
- Rear wiper activates automatically when reversing (if front wipers are on).
- Windscreen washer sprays fluid when the stalk is pulled towards the driver.
- Rear window washer activated by pressing the lever end.
- Wipers return to park position when off and bonnet is closed.
- Blades should be replaced regularly and never used on dry glass.
Mirrors: - Exterior mirrors can be adjusted electrically from the driver's door panel.
- Folding function may be automatic when locking/unlocking the vehicle.
- Heated mirrors activate with the rear defrost function.
- Auto-dimming function reduces glare from trailing vehicles.
- Interior mirror also features auto-dimming based on ambient light.
Sun protection: - Sun visors can be rotated to the side and extended to block glare.
- Some models feature illuminated vanity mirrors.
- Roof sunshades (if panoramic roof equipped) can be opened/closed electrically.
- Do not obstruct sun protection elements to avoid damaging the mechanism.
- Tinted windows and heat-reflecting glass enhance sun protection and cabin cooling.
